title: The Court That Never Was — Episode 1

characters.persona: the man who calls himself a judge
his first client, a man out of time

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In that corridor, Morris Samuel Christian knew more law than any man standing there. He had typed ten thousand orders with his own hands. Ten thousand. And not one of them carried his name.
lines.sfx_cue: court corridor voices and shuffling files

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Today, for the first time in fifteen years, somebody was going to call him sir. And that one word would destroy his life.

lines.speaker: SENIOR COUNSEL
lines.text: No no no. Delete that whole paragraph. The application was dismissed, not disposed. From the top.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Sir, yesterday's order is saying disposed. I typed it myself.

lines.speaker: SENIOR COUNSEL
lines.text: Yesterday's order was mine. This one is also mine. Your job is the machine, not the meaning.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Let me finish the citations only. I can sit inside till lunch.

lines.speaker: SENIOR COUNSEL
lines.text: You can sit outside till I call. Client is coming.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Six pages I have already typed.

lines.speaker: SENIOR COUNSEL
lines.text: And for six pages you have been paid. Kindly close the door from that side.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fifteen years back, the bar council had thrown him out. No degree, they said. Not a real advocate, they said. He still came to that court every single morning. He simply came carrying typing paper instead of a file.
lines.sfx_cue: door opening onto crowded court corridor

lines.speaker: COURT CLERK
lines.text: Oye. Move from the chamber door. Advocates that side, litigants near the railing.
lines.sfx_cue: court corridor voices and shuffling files

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: I am attached to this chamber.

lines.speaker: COURT CLERK
lines.text: Attached? Then your chair also must be attached, no? Go and sit on it.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CORRIDOR
lines.text: Attached, he is saying! Arre, maybe he is the stapler!

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: One day this record will show who knows the work in this building.

lines.speaker: COURT CLERK
lines.text: The record is showing one typist blocking my corridor. Shall I write that also?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Forty-three years old. Twenty-two years inside that building. And in front of thirty people, he was standing there with a bundle of paper, being told where to put his chair.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Sir. Sir, please. Urgent matters you are hearing today?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Who sent you here?

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Registry sent me up. Upstairs sent me down. Since ten fifteen I am going up-down, up-down, sir. Nobody is even looking at my face.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: What is the matter?

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: My mother's room, sir. Landlord has put a new lock this morning. Her medicines are inside only. Her BP tablets, sir. She is sitting on the landing since nine o'clock.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: You have an advocate?

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: He is asking twelve hundred before he even opens the file. Twelve hundred, sir. I am having four hundred and sixty. That also is my mother's.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Then go to legal aid.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: They gave me one token. Sixty-eight. Board is still showing twenty-three. By evening they will close and she will sleep on that landing.

lines.speaker: COURT CLERK
lines.text: Arre, don't waste your time with him. Can't you see, he himself has been sent out to wait?

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Sent out... from inside the chamber?

lines.speaker: COURT CLERK
lines.text: Haan! Along with the other furniture!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the whole corridor laughed. Advocates. Clerks. Litigants. Even the man selling tea stopped pouring, to laugh.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Bas.

lines.speaker: COURT CLERK
lines.text: Ji, sir. Certainly, sir. Whatever you order, sir.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That was the joke. That everybody laughed at. That he should ever order anything.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Boy. Give the file here.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Landlord is saying agreement finished on the first. My mother is saying he took three months advance. Receipt is not there.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: And the lock he changed today itself?

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Nine o'clock, sir.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Show me his notice. This notice is giving seven days. Delivered yesterday. And he broke the lock this morning.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Meaning?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Meaning your landlord has already broken his own paper. This affidavit has no verification. This application is asking final relief as interim relief. Who drafted this rubbish?

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: One man near the photocopy shop. Sir... can it be heard or not?

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Not like this.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Then you tell me how! Please, sir. Whatever you say, exactly that I will write. Ten seconds you looked at that file. Ten seconds. That advocate is holding it since two months.

lines.speaker: COURT CLERK
lines.text: Ei ei ei! What are you doing! Get up!

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: Get up. Get up, I am saying.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: No sir. Not until you are saying yes.

lines.speaker: morris
lines.text: People are watching.

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Let them watch!

lines.speaker: irfan
lines.text: Sir. Hear the case.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thirty people were watching. Ten minutes ago they were laughing at him. And now a man was on the floor, holding his feet, calling him sir.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Morris did not correct him. He did not say, I am only a typist. He did not say, they threw me out fifteen years back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He said nothing at all. And in that silence, a court was born that no country in the world had ever created.
